control.change_summary: Implement the headless Codespaces emergency/faculty-verification environment and repository-aware launcher. Use Ubuntu 22.04 and Python 3.10 as the SOE baseline/minimum; preserve compatible newer native installations. Adopt SOE/CSO schema 3.2 names and paths. VM launchers remain deferred and Vagrant optional. This remains a development draft, not an approved institutional release.

ubuntu_headless.notes: Headless Ubuntu 22.04 Codespaces runtime with provider-managed VS Code. No desktop services or Vagrant.

codio_cvd.notes: Reference deployment profile for the provider baseline master and STEM course master workflows.

windows_bare_metal.notes: Supported Windows 10 or Windows 11 computer outside S mode.

windows_sandbox.notes: Faculty and development test profile; not a student production environment.

macos_bare_metal.notes: Clean supported macOS installation on Apple silicon used for platform conformance testing.

ubuntu_gnome_bare_metal.notes: Native Ubuntu GNOME deployment; Ubuntu 22.04 is the minimum baseline.

ubuntu_vagrant_guest.notes: Planned SOE desktop guest. Launch with a compatible installed provider and released provider/architecture-specific box. Vagrant and hypervisors belong on the host and are excluded from guest requirements. No box release is assumed to exist.

github_codespaces.notes: Headless emergency student environment and faculty reference verification using Ubuntu 22.04/Python 3.10 and the selected course CSO. Access and funding remain subject to actual GitHub account/organization policy.

github_actions_ubuntu.notes: Planned explicit Ubuntu 24.04 runner target. Verify manifests, resolution, and runtime requirements without desktop installation, personal settings, or interactive login. VM startup qualification requires a separately suitable runner; nested virtualization is not assumed.

cvd_course_master_student.display_name: CVD STEM Course Master Student Initialization

runtime_initial_install.notes: Resolve standalone SOE or course CSO, select the runtime deployment, and provision only applicable requirements. Skip interactive login and personal/global settings; consume ambient credentials only when an operation needs access, never prompt or persist token values.

runtime_verify.notes: Read-only verification of the selected runtime. Report unmet requirements; do not install, update, authenticate interactively, or require equality with a reference machine.

soe_virtualbox_amd64.notes: Build the shared SOE box first; SOE-only courses reuse it. Add real release version and complete single-file or multipart distribution with verified SHA-256 metadata before enabling. GitHub release parts must each be under 2 GiB. Reconstruct and verify multipart boxes on the host before Vagrant imports them.

soe_vagrant.display_name: Launch SOE or CSO with Vagrant
soe_vagrant.notes: Planned entry point: run vagrant up in Atlas for the SOE or in a course checkout for its CSO. Respect explicit provider and environment preferences; prefer VirtualBox otherwise. Enable only after launcher, host acquisition, guest provisioning, and matching box artifacts are implemented and qualified.

github_codespaces.notes: Implemented by scripts/launch_codespaces.py. Resolves the selected checkout's origin and branch; validates its Codespaces configuration before opening GitHub's creation page. GitHub confirms access, machine selection, and billing.

vscode_web.display_name: Edit in VS Code for Web
vscode_web.notes: Browser editing and commits with supported workspace settings/extensions; native Python execution, terminal tasks, and debugging require Codespaces or another compute runtime. Existing Actions may provide checks after a commit. Configuration paths are optional editor inputs, not evidence of installed runtime capabilities. Private faculty access remains enforced by GitHub.
